question: Let $P(x)=ax^2+bx+c$ and $Q(x)=-ax^2+bx+c$, where $ac\ne0$. Consider the polynomial $P(x)Q(x)$

options.B: None of its roots is real
options.C: At least two of its roots are real
options.D: Exactly two of its roots are real
